reason: A directly targets high-temperature coating wear through a plausible, measurable oxide-tribolayer mechanism and can be decisively tested by controlled-atmosphere wear experiments with surface analysis. B relies on an overly specific 500 °C microstructural optimum extrapolated from compositionally different, thick sprayed CoCrFeNiMn coatings whose cited wear tests were at room temperature, so its proposed nanotwin/hardness mechanism is poorly grounded for FeNiCrCoCu thin films in high-temperature service.
